original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚拉各斯警方拘留一名助理警司，涉枪击致女孩死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚拉各斯州警察局拘留了一名助理警司（ASP），该警员涉嫌在拉各斯Ajegunle地区Nosamu一带开枪，导致一名年轻女孩死亡、另一名女孩受伤。警方发言人Abimbola Adebisi于周六发表声明证实此事，称事件发生在周四晚9时30分至10时之间，该警员据称在警方行动中开枪。初步调查显示，该警员是因两伙人因收取通行费发生暴力冲突的求助电话而被派往该地区。

key_facts.fact: 拉各斯州警察局拘留一名助理警司，涉枪击致一名女孩死亡、另一名女孩受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: THE Police Command in Lagos State has detained an Assistant Superintendent of Police (ASP) over the fatal shooting of a young girl and injury of another in Nosamu area of Ajegunle, Lagos.

key_facts.fact: 警方发言人Abimbola Adebisi于周六发表声明证实此事
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Police Public Relations Officer (PPRO), Abimbola Adebisi, a superintendent of police, confirmed this in a statement on Saturday.

key_facts.fact: 事件发生在周四晚9时30分至10时之间，该警员据称在警方行动中开枪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Adebisi said the incident occurred on Thursday between 9.30 p.m. and 10.00 p.m., when the ASP allegedly discharged his firearm during a police operation.

key_facts.fact: 死者为Omole Taiwo，另有一名女孩受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: She identified the deceased as Omole Taiwo, adding that another girl sustained injuries in the incident.

key_facts.fact: 初步调查显示该警员因两伙人因收取通行费发生暴力冲突的求助电话而被派往该地区
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The PPRO said preliminary findings showed that the officer was deployed to the area following a distress call over a violent clash between two rival groups over toll collection.

uncertainties: 该警员开枪的具体情形目前仅为警方初步说法，尚待进一步调查核实
事件目前仅有一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
